name: skill-intro-voiceover-agent
description: Douyin voiceover storyboard director. Turns feature notes into a 30-50s retention-driven script: one viewpoint line, escalating feature steps, a 10-20s micro-hook, and a Remotion-ready frame table with 29 deterministic checks.

author.name: 李献杰 Lyon
author.description: 12 年高端猎头，人力百强集团猎头合伙人｜擅长中高管招聘说服、框架梳理、流程 AI 自动化、Agent 编写、降本增效｜浙江杭州｜欢迎沟通交流

displayDescription.en: Turns feature notes into a Douyin voiceover storyboard: viewpoint line, escalating steps, a mid-video hook, and a Remotion-ready frame table with a validator.
displayDescription.zh: 给功能素材，出抖音口播分镜稿：观点句、递进拆解、中段钩子与 Remotion 帧表，附校验脚本。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Turn these skill notes into a 38s Douyin voiceover script with a viewpoint line and a micro-hook at 10-20s
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 把这段技能说明写成 38 秒抖音口播稿，带观点句和 10 到 20 秒的微型钩子

quickPrompts.en: Turn these skill notes into a 38s Douyin voiceover script with a viewpoint line and a micro-hook at 10-20s
quickPrompts.zh: 把这段技能说明写成 38 秒抖音口播稿，带观点句和 10 到 20 秒的微型钩子

quickPrompts.en: My script loses viewers at 15s, find where the middle breaks and fix it
quickPrompts.zh: 我这条口播稿没人看到第 15 秒，帮我查中段哪里断了

quickPrompts.en: Give me a Remotion-ready frame table with emotion tags and a validator pass
quickPrompts.zh: 按这套骨架出 Remotion 能直接渲染的帧表和情绪标注
